name: 𧾷
hosts: 路跟跑露距跳踪践跨跃蹈跌踢跪踩踏蹲躁趴踊蹦蹋蹬蹄跤跋趾跛跷跺踱蹂蹭躏
says: The side form of 足 (foot): a knee over a foot. It marks walking, jumping and the feet.

name: 亼
hosts: 合给命验拿险答签输检脸哈偷搭塔愈剑愉拾盒捡恰喻洽鸽逾俭瘩敛蛤渝榆
says: A lid over a line (人 over 一), meaning to gather together. In 合 (join) it may picture a lid on a pot.

name: 吅
hosts: 品器操哭骂癌壤澡燥灌罐噪噩躁囊嚣镶嚷藻咒鄂愕臊鳄瓤
says: Two 口 (mouth) side by side: many mouths making noise. Often it is just two boxes for shape.

name: 圭
hosts: 街封佳挂鞋哇涯娃桂崖蛙硅卦闺洼褂
says: Two 土 (earth) stacked: a jade tablet held at court. It gives the sound gui/gua/wa/jia.

name: 旲
hosts: 模幕莫摸漠寞墓慕膜募暮馍摹蟆
says: The middle of 莫: a sun sinking among grass at dusk. It gives the sound mo/mu in 模, 摸, 墓, 慕.

hosts: 统育流充弃撤蔬疏梳澈硫辙琉
says: An upside-down child (the top, 亠 over 厶) above 月 (flesh, body): a baby being born. Hence to give birth, to raise, to educate.

name: 𰀢
hosts: 监临览蓝鉴篮滥尴槛榄揽缆
says: An upright eye with a person bending over it: someone looking down. It brings the idea of watching in 监, 临, 览.

name: 刖
hosts: 前输偷愈箭愉剪喻煎逾渝榆
says: A knife beside 月 (flesh): cutting off the feet as punishment. In its characters it is the old 前 and gives the sound qian/yu.

name: 龸
hosts: 常党堂掌尝赏偿撑膛裳棠
says: Sparks over a roof, the top of 尚 (esteem). It gives the sound chang/tang/dang in 常, 堂, 党.

hosts: 营劳荣捞唠荧莹莺涝萤
says: From 鶯: 鳥 (bird) for the meaning plus the top of 熒 (glowing) as the sound. The simplified form writes the fire top as 艹 (grass) over 冖 (cover), as in 荧 (glow), and 鳥 as 鸟.

name: 曷
hosts: 喝揭渴遏葛歇竭褐蔼蝎
says: A mouth over a beggar: meaning why or how. It gives the sound he/ke/jie in 喝 (drink), 渴 (thirsty), 揭 (lift off).

name: 匃
hosts: 喝揭渴遏葛歇竭褐蔼蝎
says: A variant of 丐 (beggar), maybe a person holding out a hand. Origin unclear; here it is the lower part of 曷.

name: 亾
hosts: 喝揭渴遏葛歇竭褐蔼蝎
says: An old form of 亡 (lose, die): a person hidden in a corner. Here it is only part of 曷 and 匃.

name: 夗
says: A kneeling person (卩) at night (夕), turning over in sleep. Gives the sound yuan/wan (怨, 碗, 宛, 苑, 婉).
A drawing of an ancestral shrine, where offerings were presented; the meaning shifted to feasting and to enjoying. The bottom of the shrine was later written like 子 (child).

name: 佥
says: Simplified 僉: people and mouths gathered under one roof, meaning all, together. Gives the sound jian/qian/lian (检, 签, 险, 脸).

name: 𠮛
says: One (一) over mouth (口): the top of 畐 (a full jar), its neck and opening. Shape only.

name: 𡰪
says: Left part of 辟 (royal law): a bent person (尸) with a mouth or ring (口); with 辛 (blade) it meant punishment. Shape only alone.

name: 𤴓
says: A line over a foot (龰, from 止 foot): lower part of 是 (is) and 定 (settle). Mostly shape.

name: 刍
says: Simplified 芻: hands gathering cut grass, fodder. Gives the sound zhou/chu (皱, 雏, 趋); in 急, 稳, 隐 it is shape only.
石 (stone) as the sound and meaning plus 火 (fire, now 灬) below: a stone pot over a fire, to cook (later 煮). The meaning 'numerous, common people' is a loan; the stone wore into 广 + 廿.

name: 㐫
says: A pattern (文) in a pit (凵); in 离 and 禽 it was a net or a creature's head, in 脑 a skull. Shape only.

name: 甬
says: Originally a hanging bell, later borrowed for a walled path. Gives the sound yong/tong (通, 痛, 勇, 涌, 桶).

name: 俞
says: Origin unclear; often read as a boat hollowed from a log. Gives the sound yu/tou/shu (愉, 喻, 榆, 偷, 输).

name: 厃
says: A person (⺈) over a cliff (厂), looking up or about to fall: top of 危 (cliff edge). Gives the sound wei/gui (危, 跪, 诡).

name: 夋
says: A person with dragging feet (夂): to dawdle. Gives the sound jun/suan/suo (俊, 峻, 骏, 酸, 梭).
㫃 (waving flag, 方 + 𠂉) for the meaning plus 也 (also) as the sound: first a flag unfurling, then to spread out, to grant, to carry out.

name: 夆
says: A foot (夂) reaching a plant or pole (丰): meeting, butting. Gives the sound feng/peng (峰, 锋, 蜂, 逢, 蓬).

name: 咅
says: Spit coming out of a mouth (口). Gives the sound bu/pei/pou (部, 培, 倍, 陪, 剖).

name: 畐
says: A jar full of something: fullness. Gives the sound fu (富, 福, 幅, 辐, 蝠) and bi (逼).

name: 尃
says: A hand (寸) with a seedling (甫), spreading: to announce. Gives the sound bo/fu (博, 薄, 傅, 缚, 搏).

name: 壴
says: A drum on a stand with a decoration on top. Brings drums into 鼓 (drum), 彭 and 喜; sound or shape in 膨, 嘻.

name: 喿
says: Three mouths (品) on a tree (木): birds chirping. Gives the sound zao/cao (操, 澡, 燥, 噪, 躁).

name: 亍
says: Right half of 行 (crossroads): a small step. Characters framed by 行 are about roads and moving (街, 衔, 衙).

name: 㐱
says: A person (人) with long strands of hair (彡). Gives the sound zhen/chen (珍, 诊, 疹, 趁).

name: 尗
says: Original form of 菽 (beans), a bean plant; borrowed for uncle. Gives the sound shu/du/ji (叔, 淑, 督, 寂).

name: 冋
says: A frame (冂) around an opening (口), part of 尚 (esteem). With 尚 it gives the sound tang/chang (躺, 敞, 倘, 趟, 淌).

name: 𢦏
says: A halberd (戈) with a cross (十), meaning to cut or harm. Gives the sound zai/cai (载, 栽, 哉, 裁); shape in 截, 戴.
糸 (thread) inside a frame of hands or hemp stalks: twisting fibres into a big rope. From rope came to bind, to search, to demand. One reading sees two hands, another stripped hemp.

name: 𠀐
says: Top of 贵 (expensive): 中 over 一, from an old picture of hands holding a basket. With 贝 it gives the sound gui/kui.

name: 㐬
says: An upside-down newborn with flowing water or hair: birth, flowing. Gives the sound liu/shu (流, 硫, 琉, 疏, 梳).

name: 𠦝
says: The sun (日) among plants (十 above and below): dawn, left part of 朝 (dawn). Gives the sound han/gan in 韩, 翰, 乾.

name: 疋
says: Picture of a foot and leg, close to 足 (foot); borrowed for a bolt of cloth. Shape or sound in 楚, 疑, 蛋.

name: 㐭
says: A granary with a roof: to store grain. Gives the sound lin/dan/shan (禀, 凛, 檀, 擅, 颤).

From 堅: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 臤 (firm; a hand 又 holding a servant's eye 臣) as the sound: hard, firm earth. The simplified form writes 臣 (eye) as two short strokes, keeping 又 (hand) and 土 (earth).

name: 𠬤
says: A hand (又) over the 举-bottom: simplified right side of 择 and 泽, from 睪. Gives the sound ze/yi (择, 泽, 译, 绎).

name: 𠮷
says: Earth (土) over mouth (口) inside 周 (circuit), from an old field with crops. With 周 it gives the sound zhou/diao/chou.

name: 𢆶
says: Two silk threads (幺 doubled): tiny, faint. In 兹, 滋, 慈, 磁 it gives the sound zi/ci.

name: 呙
says: Simplified 咼: a crooked mouth (口). Gives the sound guo/wo/huo (锅, 窝, 涡, 祸, 蜗).

name: 臽
says: A person (⺈) falling into a pit (臼): a hole. Gives the sound xian/yan (陷, 馅, 焰, 阎).

name: 敝
says: Cloth beaten (攵, strike) until torn: ruined, shabby. Gives the sound bi/bie/pie (弊, 蔽, 憋, 撇, 鳖).

name: 尞
says: Original form of 燎 (burn): wood burning for a sacrifice. Gives the sound liao (僚, 撩, 嘹, 缭, 瞭).

name: 昚
says: Top of 尞: the bonfire sparks (𡗜) over 日 (sun). Shape only; the sound liao comes with 尞.

name: 帀
says: Origin unclear; means going around, everywhere. Right side of 师 (teacher), 狮 and 筛; shape in 佩.

name: 𠮦
says: Two dots (丷) over a mouth (口): top of 兑 (exchange) and 总. With 兑 it gives the sound yue (阅); shape in 总, 聪.

戈 (dagger-axe) over 止 (foot): marching with weapons, an army on campaign, hence military. The old reading 'stopping weapons' is a later moralising guess. In the modern shape the 戈 is pulled apart into a stroke plus 弋 (stake).

name: 孚
says: A hand (爫) over a child (子): brooding over eggs, or capturing. Gives the sound fu (俘, 浮, 孵).
良 (good) as the sound, its last stroke dropped, plus 阝 (town, from 邑): first a place name, then borrowed for 'young man, husband'.

name: 孛
says: A child (子) under growing shoots: to burst out, also a comet. Gives the sound bo/bei (脖, 勃, 渤, 悖).

name: 𫝀
says: Top-left part of 侯 (marquis), from a cloth target hung for archery. Shape only; the sound hou comes with 侯.
The top of 高 (tall), a tower building, for the meaning plus 丁 (nail) as the sound: a pavilion or small roadside lodge.

name: 亘
says: Sun (日) between two lines: stretching across, lasting. Gives the sound xuan/heng (宣, 喧, 渲, 恒).

name: 肙
says: A small worm with a head (口) and body (⺝). Gives the sound juan (捐, 鹃, 娟, 绢).

name: 奄
says: Big (大) over lightning (电): sudden, covering. Gives the sound yan/an (掩, 淹, 俺, 庵).

name: 夌
says: A person with feet (夂) going over high ground: to cross, climb. Gives the sound ling/leng (凌, 陵, 菱, 棱).

name: 匋
says: A pot (缶) wrapped (勹) in a kiln: pottery. Gives the sound tao (淘, 萄, 陶, 掏).
A hand 又 (hand) offering a piece of meat (肉, written on its side as the top left) over 示 (altar): a sacrifice to the spirits.

name: 耑
says: A young plant with roots and leaves: the start of growth. Gives the sound duan/rui/chuai (端, 瑞, 喘, 揣).

name: 叟
says: A hand (又) holding a torch in a house: original form of 搜 (rummage); borrowed for old man. Gives the sound sou (搜, 艘, 嫂, 瘦).

name: 酋
says: A wine jar (酉) with marks above for aged wine; the meaning shifted to elder, chief. Gives sound zun/qiu in 尊 (honor), 遵 (obey).

name: 𡨄
says: A house (宀) being stuffed full with hands below; the shared top of 塞 (plug up) and 寨 (stockade). Adds the idea of filling and sound sai.
宀 (house) with a person among bundles of grass, and two marks below later read as ice (⺀): a person in a house bedded in straw against the cold. The middle has since fused into one block.

name: 舛
says: Two feet pointing opposite ways: contrary, mistaken. In characters mostly shape; in 舞 (dance) the feet of the dancer.

name: 㳟
says: Two hands spreading grain (氺 from 米) out under the sun; the base of 暴 (violent, once 'sun-dry'). Gives sound bao/pu.
辡 (two quarrelling convicts) as the sound, split around 瓜 (melon) for the meaning: first melon seeds, then a segment, a petal.

name: 襄
says: A robe (衣) with things packed inside; means help. Origin unclear. Gives sound xiang/rang in 镶 (set in metal), 壤 (soil).

name: 氐
says: A man bowing (氏) with a dot for the ground: low, base. Gives sound di and the 'low' sense in 低 (low), 底 (bottom).

name: 㓁
says: A roof with two strokes under it, a reduced 穴 (cave). Seen in 深 (deep), 探 (probe) where someone searches a cave.

name: 爻
says: Two X shapes: crossed lines used in divination diagrams. Shape only in 驳, 爽, 攀.

戈 (halberd) guarding 口 (an enclosed area) with a line for its border: a defended territory, the original of 國 (country) and 域 (region). It was borrowed for 'or, perhaps'. One source reads 口 as a sound part instead.

name: 𰃮
says: Simplified top of 學 (study): marks over a roof, once hands with counting sticks over a school. Shape in 学, 觉, 搅.

name: 巟
says: Vast spreading water with 亡 (lost) above: wild, barren. Gives sound huang in 荒 (wasteland), 慌 (panic), 谎 (lie).

Oracle-bone forms show a ghost holding a stick, a fearful sight: to dread. One reading takes the stick as meaning and the ghost as sound. The stick later turned into other strokes, so the bottom no longer shows either part.

name: 𠬶
says: A hand (又) holding a broom: sweeping forward step by step. Gives sound qin in 侵 (invade), 浸 (soak), 寝 (bedroom).
亻 (person) plus a hand 又 holding a broom (shortened 帚): a person sweeping forward step by step, to encroach, invade.

name: 匡
says: A box (匚) with 王 inside: originally a square basket; now to correct. Gives sound kuang in 框 (frame), 筐 (basket).
尸 (body) for the meaning plus a shortened sound part (fine clothing, with 㠭 'to spread') below: to spread out, unfold. The lower parts are worn down and no longer readable.

name: 叒
says: Three hands (又): originally the leafy mulberry tree. Shape plus the mulberry sense in 桑 (mulberry), sound sang in 嗓.

name: 咢
says: Two mouths over a sound mark: a loud drumming or startled cry. Gives sound e in 鄂, 愕 (astonished), 鳄 (crocodile).

Read by tradition as two 贝 (shells), a shell necklace, over 女 (woman): a woman's neck ornament, later a baby held at the breast. One reading sees a sound part instead. Simplified from 嬰 by the short 贝.

name: 枼
says: Leaves (世) on a tree (木): a flat slip or leaf. Gives sound die/ye and flatness in 碟 (small dish), 蝶 (butterfly).

name: 帛
says: Cloth (巾) with 白 (white) for sound: silk. Adds cloth or silk sense and sound mian/jin in 棉, 锦, 绵.

name: 㚘
says: Two men (夫) side by side; in 替 (substitute) one man stands in for another. Mostly shape.

name: 荅
says: A plant (艹) with 合 for sound: small bean; also an old form of 答 (answer). Gives sound da/ta in 搭, 塔, 瘩.

name: 爰
says: Two hands pulling on a rope between them. Gives the pulling sense and sound yuan/huan in 援 (pull up), 缓 (slack).

name: 剌
says: A bundle (束) and a knife (刂): to slash apart. Gives sound la/lai in 喇 (bugle), 赖 (depend), 懒 (lazy).

name: 敖
says: A person roving about, with a hand (攵): ramble, proud. Gives sound ao in 傲 (haughty), 熬 (simmer).

name: 並
says: Two people standing (立) next to each other: together, also. Shape plus sound in 普, 碰, 谱.

name: 昷
says: Something warm over a bowl (皿): a warm meal. Gives sound wen and warmth in 温 (lukewarm), 瘟 (pestilence).

name: 䍃
says: A hand over a pottery jar (缶): a vase or pitcher. Gives sound yao in 摇 (shake), 遥 (far away), 谣 (rumor).

name: 冡
says: A pig (豕) under a cover: covered over. Gives sound meng and the 'covered, dim' sense in 蒙, 朦 (dim moonlight).

name: 𭷔
says: A knife (刀) and an ox (牛), the lower part of 解 (untie): cutting up an ox. Adds the 'take apart' sense.

name: 啇
says: A stalk or stem where fruit hangs: base, root. Gives sound di/zhai in 滴 (droplet), 嘀 (mutter), 摘 (pluck fruit).

name: 氽
says: A person (人) over water (氺): floating. In 漆, 膝, 黎 it is mostly shape, a person over liquid.

name: 畺
says: Two fields (田) divided by lines: borders. Gives sound jiang in 疆 (frontier land), 僵 (stiff), 缰 (reins).

name: 亶
says: A granary (㐭) over 旦 for sound: abundant, sincere. Gives sound dan/shan/chan in 檀, 擅, 颤.

name: 異
says: A person with a strange head or mask, arms raised: different, unusual. Shape in 戴 (wear on head), sound in 翼 (wing).

name: 敫
says: An old musical instrument; origin unclear. Gives sound jiao/ji in 激 (surge), 缴 (submit), 邀 (intercept).

name: 詹
says: Speech (言) under a cliff-like top: talking too much. Origin unclear. Gives sound zhan/shan/yan in 瞻, 赡, 檐.

name: 𠬝
says: A hand (又) pressing down a kneeling person (卩): to subdue. Shape in 报 (report) and 服 (clothes).

name: 厷
says: An arm (𠂇) with a mark at the elbow: upper arm, round. Gives sound hong/xiong in 宏 (vast hall), 雄.

name: 丕
says: 不 with a line under it: great, grand. Gives sound pi/pei in 坯 (clay blank), 胚 (germ).

name: 犮
says: A dog with a mark on its leg, running off: to pull up. Gives sound ba in 拔 (uproot), 跋 (trek).

name: 𡰯
says: A body (尸) and a cloth (巾): wiping with a cloth. Gives sound shua and the wiping sense in 刷 (brush), 涮.
Originally a drawing of an arrow stored upside down in a case with a handle: a container, hence a case, and a letter sent in an envelope. The modern shape has broken up the picture.

name: 弍
says: Two (二) with a stake (弋): an old form of 二 (two). Sound er in 贰; shape in 腻 (greasy).
攸 (a person being washed) as the sound plus 彡 (decoration strokes) for the meaning: to adorn and tidy, then to repair and cultivate. Its 攵 is written 夂.

name: 𥃭
says: An eye (目) under a shield top: hiding behind a shield. The inside of 盾 (shield); sound and shape in 循.

name: 𪧷
says: Meat (夕 from ⺼) held by a hand (寸): offering. Gives sound jiang in 将 (about to), 蒋.

name: 𦣻
says: A head (from 頁) seen in 夏 (summer): once a big man with a head and limbs. Shape only.

name: 妟
says: A woman (女) under the sun: calm, feasting. Gives sound yan in 宴 (banquet), 堰 (weir).

Two copies of a bent shape, each a curve with hair-like marks (彡): bent, pliant things together, so 'soft, weak'. Another reading sees decorated bows that are weak in use. The modern form keeps the two halves, each like 弓 (bow) with two dots.

name: 䏍
says: The left of 能: the head and body of a bear (能 was once 'bear'). Shape in 能 and 熊 (bear).

name: 妾
says: A woman (女) under a tattoo needle (辛, now 立): a servant, concubine. Gives sound jie in 接 (connect).

name: 罙
says: A person searching inside a cave; original form of 探 (probe). Gives the deep sense and sound shen/tan.

name: 匊
says: Rice (米) wrapped in a hand (勹): a handful. Gives sound ju in 菊 (chrysanthemum), 鞠 (leather ball).

name: 厓
says: A cliff (厂) with earth (圭) for sound: cliff, shore. Gives sound ya and the edge sense in 崖 (cliff), 涯.

name: 㝵
says: A hand (寸) grabbing a shell (once 貝, money): obtain. Old form of 得; shape and sound in 碍 (obstruct).

name: 㕣
says: A hollow (口) with two strokes above, the old word for a marsh. Shape only in 商 (commerce) and 橘 (tangerine).

name: 忝
says: 天 with a heart (⺗) below: shame, unworthy. Gives sound tian in 添 (top up), 舔 (lick).

name: 刅
says: A blade (刃) with an extra dot: an old word for wound, to create. Shape and sound liang in 梁 (beam bridge), 粱.

name: 佰
says: A person (亻) with 百 (hundred): hundred. In 宿 (lodge) it was once a person on a mat; shape there.

name: 宓
says: A roof (宀) with 必 for sound: quiet, still. Gives sound mi in 密 (secret), 蜜 (honey).

name: 彦
says: A man with decorative lines (彡): elegant, learned. Gives sound yan in 颜 (complexion), 谚 (proverb).

name: 陏
says: A mound (阝) with 有: falling, following. Gives sound duo/tuo in 堕 (degenerate), 椭 (oval).

name: 黾
says: A frog or toad drawn with big belly and legs. In characters it gives a sound (sheng/ying in 绳 (cord), 蝇 (housefly)).

name: 玨
says: Two pieces of jade (玉) side by side, meaning gems mounted together. At the top of 琴 (zither) and 瑟 it stands for the instrument's strings and bridges.

name: 𫥎
says: Simplified form of 毚 (crafty hare): a hare (免) with extra marks. It gives the sound chan in 馋 (greedy) and 搀 (lend an arm).
Simplified from 廚: 广 (building) for the meaning plus 尌 as the sound: the room where food is made. The standard took an old variant with 厂 (cliff shelter) on top.

name: 倠
says: A person (亻) with a bird (隹). In 鹰 (eagle) and 雁 (wild goose) it shows a bird kept or hunted by people.

name: 贲
says: Grass-like top over a shell (贝); meaning energetic, bursting forth. It gives the sound fen/pen in 愤 (indignant) and 喷 (spurt).

name: 肰
says: Meat (⺼) of a dog (犬). Under fire it made 然 (burn, later 'just so'); it gives the sound ran.

name: 㒸
says: Two strokes over a pig (豕); meaning obey, follow. Origin unclear; it gives the sound sui in 隧 (tunnel) and 遂 (follow through).

name: 𤴔
says: A side form of 疋 (foot) in 疏 (dredge) and 蔬 (vegetables), where it gives the sound shu.

name: 咠
says: A mouth (口) at an ear (耳): to whisper. It gives the sound ji in 辑 (edit) and 缉 (close stitch).

name: 𦐇
says: Sun (日) over wings (羽). It gives the sound ta in 塌 (cave in) and 蹋 (stamp flat); shape origin unclear.

name: 耆
says: Old (老) over 日: a man of sixty, aged. It gives the sound qi/shi in 嗜 (addiction) and 鳍 (fish fin).

name: 𠳋
says: Top part of 遣 (dispatch) and 谴 (condemn), giving the sound qian. Shape only; origin unclear.

name: 𢼸
says: Long hair (𡵂) with a striking hand (攵). It gives the sound wei and the idea of small in 微 (tiny) and 薇 (fern).

name: 𡵂
says: Looks like mountain (山) over 兀, but it is an old drawing of long hair, seen inside 微 (tiny) and 薇 (fern).

name: 畀
says: Once an arrow with a large head; borrowed to mean give. It gives the sound bi in 鼻 (nose) and 痹 (numbness).

name: 朔
says: The first day of the lunar month: 屰 (sound) with moon (月). It gives the sound su in 塑 (clay model) and 溯 (upstream).

name: 𬜯
says: Grass (艹) over 两 (pair), a simplified form of the part 㒼 that gives the sound man in 满 (full) and 瞒 (hide truth).

name: 翏
says: Feathers (羽) over 㐱: the sound of the wind, soaring high. It gives the sound liao/miu in 谬 (absurd) and 寥 (sparse).

name: 𡱒
says: A body (尸) over 共: an old way of writing buttocks. Seen in 臀 (buttocks) and 殿 (palace hall), giving the sound dian/tun.

name: 欶
says: Bundle (束) with open mouth (欠): to suck, to drink. In 嗽 (throat clear) and 漱 (gargle) it gives sound and the mouth idea.

name: 皃
says: A face (白) over a person (儿): appearance, countenance. Old form of 貌 (appearance); in 藐 (slight) it gives the sound mao/miao.

name: 𠤕
says: 匕 and 矢 inside 疑 (doubt) and 凝 (congeal); from an old drawing of a person turning back, unsure. Gives the sound yi/ning.

name: 桼
says: A tree (木) with sap dripping (氺): the varnish tree, lacquer. It gives the sound qi/xi in 漆 (lacquer) and 膝 (knee).

name: 覃
says: Once a jar with salt; meaning deep, extensive. It gives the sound tan in 谭 (deep talk) and 潭 (pool).

name: 敕
says: Bundle (束) with a striking hand (攵): an imperial order, to put right. In 整 (tidy) and 嫩 (tender) it gives the sound and the 'arrange' idea.

name: 復
says: Step (彳) with 复 (return): to go back, repeat. Traditional form of 复; it gives the sound fu in 覆 (overturn) and the walking part of 履 (footwear).
艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 辥 (sickle and moon, a word for crime) as the sound: a kind of grass; now a surname and an old state. Early forms were a sickle with the moon.

name: 溥
says: Water (氵) with 尃 (spread): big, vast. It gives the sound bo/bu in 薄 (thin) and 簿 (ledger).

name: 耤
says: Plow (耒) with 昔 (sound): to plow a field. It gives the sound ji/jie in 籍 (register) and 藉 (straw mat).

name: 粦
says: Sparks (米) over feet (舛): flickering ghost lights, phosphorus. It gives the sound lin in 磷 (phosphorus) and 鳞 (fish scales).

name: 𡬠
says: Lower part of 爵: a bird-shaped wine goblet held by a hand (寸). In 爵 (noble rank) and 嚼 (chew) it gives the sound jue.

name: 翟
says: Feathers (羽) over a bird (隹): a long-tailed pheasant. It gives the sound yao/chuo in 耀 (dazzle) and 戳 (poke).

name: 雚
says: A bird (隹) with crest and two mouths (吅) crying: a heron or stork. It gives the sound guan in 灌 (irrigate) and 罐 (jar).
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 雚 (heron) as the sound: to pour water in, to irrigate.

name: 圡
says: Earth (土) with an extra dot, an old variant of 土. In 压 (press down) it is the earth being pressed.
From 傷: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus a sound part with 昜 (sunrise) at the bottom: a wound. The simplification put 力 (strength) in place of 昜.

name: 𠠵
says: 九 with strength (力), the right side of 抛 (fling). Shape only; origin unclear.

name: 㐌
says: A form of 它 (snake). In 拖 (drag) it gives the sound tuo beside a hand.

name: 𢆉
says: The top of 幸 (lucky), which first drew handcuffs. Shape only now.

name: 氾
says: Water (氵) with 㔾: to flood, overflow. It gives the sound fan in 范 (model pattern).

name: 厈
says: Cliff (厂) with 干 (sound gan): a steep bank. In 岸 (shore) it gives sound and the cliff idea.

name: 㝉
says: A roof (宀) over a shelf line: a place to store things. In 贮 (stockpile) it gives sound and meaning.
Simplified from 飾: 飤 (to feed) as the sound plus 巾 (cloth) for the meaning, cloth for wiping and adorning. The 人 (person) of 飤 has become 𠂉, and 食 (food) became 饣.
阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 㔷 (a box 匚 around 丙) as the sound, lòu: a narrow, cramped place, hence crude, mean, ugly.

name: 夅
says: Two feet pointing downward: to come down. In 降 (descend) it gives sound and meaning.

name: 㓞
says: Notches (丰) cut with a knife (刀): a carved tally, a contract. In 契 (contract) it gives sound and meaning.

name: 穵
says: A cave (穴) with 乙: a deep hollow, to dig out. In 挖 (dig) it gives sound and meaning.
From the older 荼 (艹 plant + 余 as the sound), the name of a bitter plant. Around the Tang dynasty one stroke was dropped to make 茶, a separate character just for tea.

name: 汒
says: Water (氵) with 亡 (sound mang). In 茫 (boundless haze) it gives the sound and the wide-water idea.

name: 劦
says: Three 力 (strength): many working together. In 荔 (lychee) it gives the sound li.

name: 𠠴
says: Two 力 (strength) side by side, the lower part of 劦 inside 荔 (lychee). Shape only on its own.

name: 㫗
says: 日 over 子 inside 厚 (thick), from an old drawing of a heavy pot. Shape only now.
Traditional 罰 is 詈 (to scold: 罒 net over 言 speech) plus 刂 (knife): a scolding or a cut as penalty for a crime. Simplified by writing 言 (speech) as 讠.
From 獄: two dogs, 犭 and 犬, with 言 (words) between them, barking: a jail with guard dogs. 言 was shortened to 讠.

name: 𠂢
says: A stream splitting into branches, the right side of 派 (river branch); a mirror of 永.

name: 氿
says: Water (氵) with 九 (sound jiu): a spring. In 染 (dye) it is the dye liquid over wood (木).

name: 㝴
says: Head (元) with a hand (寸), inside 冠 (cap): a hand putting a cap on a head.

name: 夃
says: 乃 with a hand (又): an old word for profit. In 盈 (full vessel) it gives the idea of more than enough.

name: 厽
says: Three 厶 shapes: piled lumps of earth. In 垒 (rampart) it gives sound and meaning.

name: 圤
says: Earth (土) with 卜: a clod of soil. In simplified 盐 (table salt) it is only a shape.

name: 圼
says: Sun (日) over earth (土): black mud, slime. In 捏 (pinch) it gives the sound nie.

name: 犾
says: Two dogs (犭 and 犬) facing each other, dogs fighting. In simplified 获 (capture) it is a hunting dog.

name: 匝
says: A box (匚) round a cloth (巾): a full circle. It gives the sound za in 砸 (pound).
A late character from 卓 (tall) as sound and meaning plus 木 (wood): a raised wooden table. 木 took the place of the bottom 十 of 卓, so only the top of 卓 is left over 木.
From 澀: 歰 (four 止 feet, stuck) for the meaning, with 氵 (water) added later: rough, not flowing smoothly. The simplification wrote 歰 as 刃 (blade) over 止 (foot).

name: 闵
says: Door (门) with 文: to mourn, grieve. In 悯 (compassion) it gives sound and meaning beside the heart.

name: 苋
says: Grass (艹) with 见 (sound): amaranth greens. In 宽 (spacious) it gives the sound kuan.

name: 昗
says: 日 over 六 inside 冥 (gloom). Shape only; origin unclear.

name: 囷
says: Grain (禾) in an enclosure (囗): a round grain bin. It gives the sound jun in 菌 (mushroom).

name: 泙
says: Water (氵) with 平 (level). In 萍 (duckweed) it is the flat water the weed floats on, and gives the sound ping.

name: 㸚
says: Four crosses (乂), a pattern of openings. In 爽 (refreshing) they are the gaps letting air or light through.

name: 攸
says: A person (亻) and a striking hand (攵); meaning distant. Origin unclear. In 悠 (leisurely) it gives the sound you.

name: 歨
says: Two feet, one after the other: an old form of 步 (step). In 徙 (migrate) it is the walking.

name: 𬎿
says: The top of 兽 (beast), from a forked hunting weapon or net used to catch animals.

name: 洰
says: Water (氵) with 巨 (sound ju): a ditch, a channel. In 渠 (canal) it gives sound and meaning.
From 淵: the right side is a picture of a basin with swirling water between banks; 氵 (water) was added later: a deep pool, abyss. The simplified form drew the inside as 米.

name: 㸒
says: A hand (爫) over 壬: reaching for too much. In 淫 (lewd) it gives sound and the idea of excess.

name: 仒
says: The right part of 於, a person with two dots, from the crow's feathers. Shape only.

name: 迶
says: 有 (sound) with walking (辶): to walk. In 随 (tag along) it gives the walking part.

name: 叕
says: Four hands (又) joined: to connect. In 缀 (stitch on) it gives sound and meaning.
文 (pattern) for the meaning set inside a shortened 班 (divide), whose two jades remain, as the sound: spotted, striped, mottled.
One reading: first 歀, 柰 as the sound plus 欠 (lacking, longing): desire, sincerity; 木 in 柰 later became 士. Shuowen reads it differently. Now funds and items.

name: 匽
says: A woman (女) behind a screen (匚): to hide. In 堰 (weir) it gives the sound yan.

name: 臿
says: A pestle (千) in a mortar (臼): to husk grain. In 插 (insert) it gives sound and the pushing-in idea.

name: 匍
says: Wrap (勹) with 甫 (sound): to crawl, lie flat. In 葡 (vine fruit) it gives the sound pu.

name: 怱
says: Hurry (匆) with heart (心): hastily. In 葱 (scallion) it gives the sound cong.

name: 丵
says: Dense, thick grass. In 凿 (chisel) it is the top of a tool hitting into something.

name: 昍
says: Two suns (日) side by side, a bright light. In 晶 (crystal) it is part of three suns, sparkling.

name: 𣢟
says: 甘 (sweet) over 欠 (open mouth): an old character for a hollow or pit. In 嵌 (inlay) it gives the sound and the idea of a hollow to fill.

name: 眇
says: 目 (eye) + 少 (little): an eye that sees little, blind in one eye; then 'tiny, far off'. In 渺 (faraway water) it gives sound and the sense of vast distance.

name: 斿
says: A child (子) holding a flag: the streamers on a flag's edge, then 'to drift, swim'. In 游 (swim) it gives the sound and the drifting.
忄 (heart) for the meaning plus a shortened 楞 (edge) as the sound, with its 木 (tree) dropped: dazed, blank-minded. A late character.
尾 (tail) as the sound plus 牛 (ox) for the meaning: an ox-like animal, the rhinoceros; also sharp. The 毛 (hair) part of 尾 has changed into a water-like shape.

name: 𡭴
says: Small bits around 日 (sun): light showing through gaps. It forms the right side of 隙 (crack) and gives the idea of a chink.

name: 𣌢
says: 日 (sun) + 小 (small): specks of light. Part of the right side of 隙 (crack); mostly shape here.

name: 胥
says: 疋 (foot) over ⺝ (flesh): first a word for crab paste, later 'all, together'. In 婿 (son-in-law) it gives the sound.

name: 彖
says: A pig (豕-like) with a bristly head: hog, porcupine. In 缘 (hem edge) it gives the sound.

name: 𡿺
says: 囟 (soft spot of a baby's skull) with hair 巛 on top: the head and brain, as in 脑. In 瑙 (carnelian) it gives the sound nao.

name: 隽
says: 隹 (bird) over 乃: first meat of a fat bird, tasty; then 'outstanding'. In 携 (carry along) it is the shape of the right side.

name: 甹
says: 由 over 丂; origin unclear. Means 'chivalrous knight'. In 聘 (hire) it gives the sound ping.

name: 祘
says: Two 示 (altar) side by side, read as counting rods laid out: 'to calculate'. In 蒜 (garlic) it gives the sound suan.

name: 烝
says: 丞 (lifting up) over 灬 (fire): steam rising from a fire. In 蒸 (steamer) it gives sound and meaning.

name: 坴
says: A plant 圥 over 土 (earth): a clod of earth, land. In 睦 (amiable) it gives the sound lu-mu.

name: 圥
says: 土 (earth) + 八: a small plant or mushroom growing from the ground, named in old texts. Top of 坴; here shape and sound.

name: 啚
says: 口 (area) over 㐭 (granary): a granary on the outskirts, a rustic border town. In 鄙 (rustic) it gives the meaning and sound.

name: 𠣜
says: 勹 (wrap) around 虫 (worm): a curled caterpillar. The lower part of 蜀 (silkworm land), whose big eye sits on top.

name: 朕
says: First hands patching a seam in a boat 舟 (written 月 now); later 'omen' and the emperor's 'I'. In 腾 (soar) it gives the sound teng.
Simplified from 穎 (頁 became 页): 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 顷 (a moment; 匕 over 页) as the sound, with 禾 tucked under the 匕. The tip of a grain ear; sharp, clever.

name: 奚
says: A hand 爫 holding a rope 幺 tied to a person 大: a slave. Later only 'why, where'. In 溪 (brook) it gives the sound xi.

name: 𡗞
says: 幺 (cord) over 大 (person): the tied person at the bottom of 奚. In 溪 (brook) shape only.

name: 衮
says: 衣 (clothing) split by 公: the emperor's ceremonial robe. In 滚 (roll boil) it gives the sound gun.

name: 冝
says: 冖 (cover) over 且 (stand): an old form of 宜 (suitable, proper). In 叠 (stack) it is the lower part, shape only.

name: 㢆
says: 广 (shelter) over 里 (village): a shop or living space in town. In 缠 (wrap around) it gives the sound chan.

name: 珀
says: 𤣩 (jade) + 白 (sound): amber, a jewel. In 碧 (jade green) it is the top part, giving jade and the sound.

name: 𦭝
says: Brows 艹 over an eye 罒: weary, dim eyes. The top of 蔑 (disdain), where it gives the sense of looking down on.

name: 戍
says: A person 人 with a halberd 戈: to guard the border. Lower part of 蔑 (disdain).

name: 谒
says: 讠 (speech) + 曷 (sound): to visit a superior and pay respects. In 蔼 (kindly) it gives the sound and a polite tone.

name: 巸
says: 𦣞 (jaw, chin) + 巳: shape only; origin unclear. The top of 熙 (bright glow), where it gives the sound xi-yi.

name: 𥃲
says: 目 over 廾 (two hands): hands working a counting tool. Under the bamboo in 算 (reckon), where it pictures counting with an abacus.

name: 舁
says: Four hands working together to lift something. In 舆 (sedan chair) the hands hold up the carriage 车.

name: 羕
says: 羊 (sound) + 永 (long flowing water): a long river. In 漾 (undulate) it gives sound and the rippling water.

name: 屚
says: Rain 雨 under a roof 尸: a roof that leaks. In 漏 (drip) it gives the meaning and the sound lou.

name: 𢼄
says: 户 (door) + 攵 (hand with stick): to open, as in 启 (open). The top of 肇 (begin), where it gives the idea of opening.

name: 彗
says: A hand 彐 holding a broom of twigs: a broom, and a comet's sweeping tail. In 慧 (bright mind) it gives the sound hui.

name: 辇
says: Two men 夫 pulling a cart 车: a hand-drawn carriage. In 撵 (drive out) it gives the sound nian.

name: 毳
says: Three 毛 (hair): fine, soft fur of animals. In 撬 (pry open) it gives the sound.

name: 㲎
says: Two 毛 (hair) side by side: the bottom of 毳 (fine fur). In 撬 (pry open) shape only.

name: 巽
says: Two kneeling people 巳巳 on a stand 共: obedient, yielding. In 撰 (compose) it gives the sound zhuan-xun.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 巽 (to arrange) as the sound: to set in order by hand, to compose and write.

name: 惢
says: Three 心 (heart): 'doubting', and pictured as a cluster of flower parts. In 蕊 (stamen) it gives the sound and the clustered look.

name: 缊
says: 纟 (silk) + 昷 (sound): tangled hemp, raveled silk. In 蕴 (store within) it gives the sound and the idea of something packed in.

name: 旉
says: 甫 (sound) + 方: to spread out, announce. In 敷 (spread on) it gives sound and meaning.

name: 盍
says: A lid 去 over a vessel 皿: first 'lid', now 'why not'. In 磕 (kowtow) it gives the sound ke.

name: 砳
says: Two 石 (stone): the sound of stones knocking. With one more 石 it makes 磊 (rock pile).

name: 沓
says: 水 (water) over 曰 (speak): words flowing like water, piled on. In 踏 (stomp) it gives the sound ta.

name: 𥝢
says: 禾 (grain) with a small part: the top of 黍 (sticky millet). In 黎 (multitude) it carries the millet idea.

name: 𢛳
says: 直 (straight, an eye looking ahead) over 心 (heart): an upright heart, the old form 悳 of virtue. The right side of 德 (virtue).

name: 孰
says: 享 (temple offering) + 丸: origin unclear, possibly offering cooked food. First 'cooked', now 'who, which'. In 熟 (cooked) it gives sound and meaning.

name: 豙
says: 立 over 𧰨 (pig): an angry boar with bristles up. In 毅 (resolute) it gives the sound yi.

name: 阑
says: 门 (door) + 柬 (sound): a railing or screen across a doorway. In 澜 (billows) it gives the sound lan.

name: 㗊
says: Four 口 (mouth): many voices, a noisy crowd. In 噩 (ill omen) the mouths are cries of mourning.

name: 矞
says: 矛 (spear) over 冏 (window): to bore with an awl. In 橘 (tangerine) it gives the sound ju-yu.

name: 冏
says: Pictures a round lattice window letting in light: bright. In 橘 (tangerine) it is the lower part of 矞, shape only.

name: 𣦼
says: 歹 (bone remnants) + 又 (hand): to pick at bones, pierce. The top of 餐 (meal), eating meat off bones.

name: 觜
says: 此 (sound) + 角 (horn): a hard beak or spout; the original form of 嘴 (beak), where it gives sound and meaning.

name: 兟
says: Two 先 (go first): to advance. The top of 赞 (praise), with 贝 (shells, gifts) presented.

name: 㣎
says: 白 + 小 over 彡: a ripe grain ear with fine hairs; 'fine, delicate'. Right side of 穆 (reverent), giving the sound mu.

name: 𩵋
says: 角 (horn) over 大: a wooden bar tied across an ox's horns. The middle of 衡 (balance), giving the crossbar idea.

name: 𦙲
says: 加 (add) over 肉 (flesh): shape only; origin unclear. Inside 瘸 (limp), where 加 gives the sound.

name: 臧
says: 戕 (sound) + 臣 (servant, an eye bowed low): a good, obedient servant; 'good'. In 藏 (hide away) it gives the sound zang.

name: 戕
says: 爿 (sound) + 戈 (halberd): to kill or wound. Part of 臧 inside 藏 (hide away).

name: 舜
says: Hands 爫 over a cover and 舛 (two feet): name of a legendary ruler, also a flower. In 瞬 (blink) it gives the sound shun.

name: 𢾰
says: 山 and 系 (cord) with 攵 (hand striking): shape only; origin unclear. Like the core of 微, it sits inside 徽 (badge) and gives the sound hui.

name: 嵒
says: Three 口 (rocks) on 山 (mountain): a cliff, piled rocks. In 癌 (cancer) it gives the sound and the lumpy rock image.

name: 吂
says: 亡 (lost) over 口 (mouth): shape only; origin unclear. The top of 赢 (win money).

name: 耦
says: 耒 (plow) + 禺 (sound): two people plowing side by side, a pair. In 藕 (lotus root) it gives the sound ou.

name: 滕
says: Water 氺 welling up, with 朕 as sound: water gushing up; also an ancient state. In 藤 (rattan) it gives the sound teng.

name: 𣳾
says: Hands 龹 over water 氺: shape only; the lower right of 滕. In 藤 (rattan) it is part of the sound.

name: 䧹
says: A bird 隹 perched on a branch: an eagle, the original form of 鷹. In 鹰 (eagle) it gives sound and meaning.

name: 棥
says: Two 木 (wood) with crossed 爻 between: a woven fence of stakes. The top of 樊 inside 攀 (climb).

name: 彊
says: 弓 (bow) + 畺 (fields with borders): a strong bow; strong, stubborn. In 疆 (frontier land) 畺 gives the boundary fields.

name: 髟
says: 镸 (long) + 彡 (hair strands): long flowing hair. The top of 鬓 (temple hair) and other hair characters.

name: 殸
says: A hanging stone 声 struck by a hand with a stick 殳: a stone chime. In 馨 (aroma) it gives the sound xin-qing.

name: 䖵
says: Two 虫 (worm, insect): insects in general. The bottom of 蠢 (dimwit), wriggling bugs.

name: 䩗
says: 革 (hide, sound) + 月 (moon): from the old meaning of 霸, the dim new moon. The lower part of 霸 (tyrant).

name: 蔺
says: 艹 (grass) + 𫔴 (sound): a rush used for mats; also a surname. In 躏 (stomp down) it gives the sound lin.

name: 𫔴
says: 门 (door) + 隹 (bird): shape only; origin unclear. The inner part of 蔺, in 躏 (stomp down).

name: 遀
says: 辶 (walk) with a hand and flesh part: to walk along, follow, as in 随. In 髓 (marrow) it gives the sound sui.
